summary: Players act as supervisors building ships, satisfying guests, and expanding a shared company network across a modular board, using action points, worker placement, and card play to invent technologies and grow their workforce over three years. Victory points themselves can be spent as a resource, so players must balance banking points for the end against using them to fuel further actions.

interaction.detail: Actions taken by one supervisor build out a shared company network that makes other players' jobs easier, so the board's connections are a common resource even as each player runs their own ships and workforce. Worker placement spots and open drafting also put players in direct competition for the same options.

scoring.why: Unknown — I don't have verified information on what actually decides the winner in this specific game.
scoring.how_you_win: The supervisor with the most success after three years takes over as CEO, built through constructing ships, satisfying guests, expanding the network, researching technologies, and managing victory points as a spendable resource.
